 Holidays Veterans Day Is a Federal Holiday: Here’s What’s Open and Closed in 2026
 Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11. What to know on banks, the post office, UPS, FedEx, the stock market and more. Nov. 10, 2026, 1:55 PM EST Sarah Lemire 
 Lifestyle Reporter
 Wednesday, Nov. 11, is a federal holiday. Find out if banks, the USPS and other outlets are open or closed.  Mint Images / Getty Images Share Add TODAY to Google Veterans Day falls on Wednesday, Nov. 11. The annual commemoration is set aside to pay tribute to U.S. military personnel and the sacrifices they’ve made in the name of their country. 
 President Woodrow Wilson established the November holiday in 1919 to recognize the end of World War I. Originally called Armistice Day, the holiday has since evolved to encompass all veterans who’ve served in the armed forces and is now observed as Veterans Day .
 In honor of the occasion, many cities and communities hold parades, events and ceremonies to honor veterans and their families. Many businesses, retailers and restaurants offer special discounts for veterans on the holiday. 
 However you plan to spend the federal holiday this year, you may be wondering what’s open and closed on Veterans Day in 2026. 
 To help, see below for a roundup of what you can expect from government agencies like the U.S. Postal Service and Social Security, as well as banks, the stock market , UPS, FedEx and retailers on Nov. 11. 
 As always, it’s a good idea to confirm local hours to ensure you’ve got the latest information. 
 Are Banks Open on Veterans Day?
 No. Most credit unions and banks, including Chase, Bank of America, M&T, TD Bank and Santander, will be closed on Wednesday, Nov. 11. 
 Branches will reopen for business as usual on Thursday, Nov. 12. As always, confirm local hours ahead of going to ensure your bank is open.
 Is the Stock Market Open on Wednesday, Nov. 11? 
 Yes. All NYSE markets will be will operate during normal trading hours on Veterans Day. Standard trading hours are from 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET.
 Note that U.S. bond markets will not be open for trading on Veterans Day.
 Will the Mail Run on Veterans Day?
 No. The USPS will be not be open on Wednesday, Nov. 11. There will not be mail delivery or pickup since Veterans Day is a federal and state holiday.
 The USPS will reopen during normal business hours on Thursday, Nov. 12. 
 Does UPS Pick Up and Deliver on Veterans Day?
 Yes. UPS will pickup and deliver as usual on Wednesday, Nov. 11. UPS store locations will also be open during normal business hours. 
 Find further details here .
 Does FedEx Pick Up and Deliver on Veterans Day?
 Yes. FedEx ground, express and freight services will run on Veterans Day, but may be modified or delayed. In some locations, FedEx may have early on-call pickups and drop box pickups, including dropbox closures. 
 FedEx Office Print & Ship Center locations will be open for business. Find local hours here. 
 Is the DMV Open on Veterans Day?
 No. Since Veterans Day is a recognized federal and state holiday, a majority of locations will be closed on Wednesday, Nov. 11. 
 Government-run agencies will reopen for business as usual on Thursday, Nov. 12. Because DMV hours may vary by state, confirm local hours ahead of visiting.
 Are Government Agencies and Offices Open on Veterans Day?
 No. A majority of federal government agencies will be closed on Wednesday, Nov. 11. 
 They include:
 Social Security offices
 Government-operated passport services
 Federal courts
 The IRS
 Certain state and local offices may operate on Veterans Day. Because of that, confirm local hours in your community ahead of visiting.
 Are Schools Open on Veterans Day?
 Yes and no. A majority of public schools are closed in observance of the Veterans Day holiday. 
 However, many colleges and universities remain open with regular classes. 
 Confirm your local school, college or university’s holiday schedule to find the most up-to-date information regarding Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 Are Stores Open on Wednesday, Nov. 11?
 Yes. Most, if not all, major retailers are open for business as usual on Wednesday, Nov. 11. See below for a list of open stores and locators to confirm hours.
